data.name: PortfolioReport_Explain_InvestedCapital_Text

data.name: PortfolioReport_Explain_UnrealizedGainLoss_Title
data.value: How the unrealized gain/loss is calculated

data.name: PortfolioReport_Explain_Twr_Title
data.value: How the time-weighted return is calculated

data.name: PortfolioReport_Explain_Twr_Text
data.value: The time-weighted return chain-links the Modified Dietz return of each calendar year since the first transaction, which removes the effect of the timing and size of deposits and withdrawals: TWR = (1 + R1) x (1 + R2) x ... x (1 + Rn) - 1. Each yearly return Ri is calculated as (end value - start value - net cashflow) / (start value + 0.5 x net cashflow).

data.name: PortfolioReport_Explain_Ytd_Title
data.value: How the year-to-date return is calculated

data.name: PortfolioReport_Explain_Ytd_Text
data.value: The year-to-date return is the Modified Dietz return for the current calendar year, from January 1st up to today: (current value - value on Jan 1st - net cashflow) / (value on Jan 1st + 0.5 x net cashflow).

data.name: PortfolioReport_Explain_NetDeposits_Text
data.value: Net deposits this year = sum of all buy transactions minus the sum of all sell transactions booked for securities in the current calendar year.

data.name: PortfolioReport_Explain_Dividends_Text
data.value: Sum of all dividend payments booked for held securities in the current calendar year (gross, before taxes).

data.name: PortfolioReport_Explain_RealizedGains_Text
data.value: Realized gains/losses this year = FIFO realized gains up to today minus the FIFO realized gains up to the end of last year, i.e. the gains/losses locked in by sell transactions executed within the current year.

data.name: PortfolioReport_Explain_LiquidityRatio_Title
data.value: How the liquidity ratio is calculated

data.name: PortfolioReport_Explain_LiquidityRatio_Text
data.value: The liquidity ratio shows which share of the current portfolio value is not tied up in securities, but held as cash on the derived settlement accounts. The higher the value, the larger the immediately available cash share compared with the invested portfolio. Mixed accounts are included with their full current balance.

data.name: PortfolioReport_Explain_LiquidityRatio_Calculation
data.value: Calculation with current values: {0} cash / ({1} market value + {0} cash) = {0} / {2} = {3}.

data.name: PortfolioReport_Explain_LiquidityRatio_NotCalculated
data.value: Current values: {0} cash and {1} market value produce a denominator of {2}. Because the derived cash balance is negative or the market value or denominator is not positive, no reliable calculation is currently possible. n/a is displayed.

data.name: PortfolioReport_Explain_Volatility_Text
data.value: Annualized standard deviation of the portfolio's periodic returns; a measure of how much the portfolio value fluctuates. Not yet calculated - planned for a future phase.

data.name: PortfolioReport_Explain_MaxDrawdown_Text
data.value: The largest observed decline from a historical peak to a subsequent trough of the portfolio value. Not yet calculated - planned for a future phase.

data.name: PortfolioReport_Explain_SharpeRatio_Text
data.value: Excess return per unit of risk: (portfolio return - risk-free rate) / volatility. Higher values indicate a better risk-adjusted return. Not yet calculated - planned for a future phase.

data.name: PortfolioReport_Explain_Beta_Text
data.value: Sensitivity of the portfolio's returns to movements of a configured benchmark index; a beta of 1.0 means the portfolio moves in line with the benchmark. Not yet calculated - planned for a future phase.

data.name: PortfolioReport_Explain_ValueAtRisk_Text
data.value: Estimated maximum loss over a given time horizon at a given confidence level (e.g. "95% confidence not to lose more than X in one day"). Not yet calculated - planned for a future phase.
